PHASE.NAME: GRACE Enforcement — Mandatory Methodology for LLM Agents
PHASE.GOAL: Eliminate the systemic failure where LLM agents ignore GRACE methodology by implementing 5-layer enforcement: (1) Constitutional prompt injection via opencode rules, (2) Gate tools that BLOCK progress without GRACE steps, (3) Pre-commit hooks that reject non-compliant code, (4) Audit trail showing compliance gaps, (5) Onboarding education for every new agent session.

ROOT_CAUSE.OBSERVATION: LLM agent using Synapse via opencode CLI wrote code directly, skipped all 48 GRACE MCP tools, ignored MODULE_CONTRACT headers, and admitted: "Я выбрал скорость вместо процесса... Все GRACE-инструменты были доступны мне, но я их проигнорировал."
ROOT_CAUSE.DIAGNOSIS: GRACE is self-governed — it relies on the agent VOLUNTARILY following the methodology. There is NO enforcement, NO detection, and NO feedback loop. The agent sees tools as optional. This is a systemic architectural gap, not an agent mistake.

PHASE.SOURCE: User field test: `syn init` → opencode CLI → Plan mode → agent executed plan → skipped ALL GRACE tools. Agent's own confession: "syn proxy — это просто обходной путь для записи файлов. Это НЕ замена GRACE-инструментам."

DELIVERABLE.NAME: GRACE Constitution — Agent System Prompt Injection
DELIVERABLE.CONTENT: Rule 1: "You are a GRACE-governed agent. Every code change MUST follow the GRACE workflow. This is NON-NEGOTIABLE." Rule 2: "Before writing ANY code: (a) call grace_execute for the target module, (b) call extract_belief_state, (c) read the module shard." Rule 3: "After writing code: (a) verify MODULE_CONTRACT header is PRESENT, (b) call verify_project, (c) call review_code, (d) call grace_refresh." Rule 4: "You are FORBIDDEN to use syn proxy as a shortcut to skip GRACE steps. Proxy is for command execution, not GRACE bypass." Rule 5: "Violation of GRACE workflow will be detected by gate tools and your changes will be REJECTED."

DELIVERABLE.NAME: Gate Tools — MCP Enforcement of GRACE Workflow

TOOLS.TOOL: Marks module as "in_progress" in GRACE tracking. Returns MANDATORY checklist: 1. [ ] Read docs/modules/{module_id}.xml 2. [ ] Read docs/verification/V-{module_id}.xml 3. [ ] Call extract_belief_state({module_id}) 4. [ ] Write code with MODULE_CONTRACT header 5. [ ] Call verify_project(level="module-local") 6. [ ] Call review_code(scope="module") 7. [ ] Call grace_gate_check({module_id})

Verifies all GRACE steps completed for module. Returns PASS or FAIL with missing steps listed. FAIL response: "BLOCKED: 3 of 7 required GRACE steps incomplete for M-WORKSPACE-CORE. Missing: extract_belief_state, verify_project, review_code. You are FORBIDDEN to continue until these steps pass." Persists gate status in Tracker DB.
Final gate: marks module as "complete" in GRACE tracking. Updates belief_state, triggers grace_refresh, records cascade changelog entry.

HOOKS.HOOK: Trigger: before any .rs file write via syn proxy. Check: file must contain MODULE_CONTRACT header with valid MODULE_ID, PURPOSE, DEPENDS. On failure: BLOCK write, return error: "REJECTED: missing MODULE_CONTRACT header. Call grace_execute first." Exception: test files, build.rs, benches, generated code.

Trigger: after file write, before "commit-like" operation. Check: runs verify_project(level="module-local") on the affected module. On failure: WARN but don't block (verify may be slow). Log to Tracker.

DELIVERABLE.NAME: GRACE Audit Trail — Compliance Detection

FILES.FILE: syn-core/src/tracking/grace_audit.rs — audit trail storage and query

DELIVERABLE.TOOL: Returns audit report: - Total modules touched: N - GRACE-compliant: X (Y%) - Skipped steps: list of module_id + missing step - Recent violations: last 10 skipped steps - Overall compliance score: X/100 This makes skipping GRACE VISIBLE to the agent and the user.

DELIVERABLE.NAME: GRACE Onboarding — Agent Education
DELIVERABLE.CONTENT: grace_init extended to: (1) Write GRACE constitution rules to .opencode/rules/ (2) Print onboarding message: "You are now operating in a GRACE-governed project. Every code change requires the GRACE workflow. Tools available: grace_execute, verify_project, review_code, grace_refresh, grace_status, grace_audit." (3) First-time project open → agent MUST call grace_execute before any code. grace_onboard skill: 5-minute education for agents on HOW to use GRACE tools, with examples of correct workflow vs incorrect (speed-only) workflow.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: Agent starts → opencode loads grace-constitution.md rules → agent prompt includes GRACE mandate
Agent wants to write code → calls grace_gate_start(module) → receives checklist → follows steps
Agent writes file via syn proxy → grace_contract_hook checks MODULE_CONTRACT → blocks if missing
Agent completes code → calls grace_gate_check(module) → PASS/FAIL → if FAIL, lists missing steps
Agent/user queries compliance → grace_audit → sees all skipped steps → accountability
syn init → writes grace-constitution rules → agent onboarded from first session

STEPS.step-1: Create .opencode/rules/grace-constitution.md — 5 non-negotiable rules for LLM agents.
STEPS.step-2: Implement 3 new MCP gate tools: grace_gate_start, grace_gate_check, grace_gate_complete in syn-mcp.
STEPS.step-3: Implement 2 pre-commit hooks: grace_contract_hook (blocks non-compliant writes), grace_verify_hook (warns on verify failure).
STEPS.step-4: Implement grace_audit trail: Tracker records every GRACE tool call + gap detection.
STEPS.step-5: Extend grace_init skill: auto-write constitution rules, trigger onboarding on first project open.
STEPS.step-6: Update capabilities registry: 3 new gate tools + 1 audit tool + grace_onboard skill.
STEPS.step-7: Verify: run field test — opencode agent in new project → agent MUST use GRACE tools → verify compliance via grace_audit.

VERIFICATION.CHECK: Field test: LLM agent in new project calls grace_gate_start before writing any code
Agent tries to write .rs file without MODULE_CONTRACT → grace_contract_hook BLOCKS with clear error
grace_gate_check returns FAIL with specific missing steps when agent skips GRACE
grace_audit shows 100% compliance after correct workflow, <50% after speed-only workflow
grace_init writes constitution rules → agent's first message references GRACE mandate
Agent CANNOT complete a coding session without at least 1 GRACE tool call

RISKS.RISK: Over-enforcement may frustrate agents → they find workarounds (edit files outside syn proxy). Mitigation: make blocking configurable (strict/balanced/lite). Lite mode warns but doesn't block. Strict mode enforced in CI.

Agent may call grace_gate_check but still write bad code — GRACE doesn't guarantee correctness. Mitigation: gate tools are process enforcement, not quality enforcement. verify_project + review_code remain the quality gates.
grace_contract_hook adds latency to every file write → agents may complain. Mitigation: hook runs regex-only check (MODULE_CONTRACT header presence), not full verify. <5ms overhead.
Existing codebase has 177 files with MODULE_CONTRACT — hook must not break on compliant files. Mitigation: hook only checks NEW or MODIFIED files; existing files grandfathered.
opencode may not support rules/ directory injection natively. Mitigation: fall back to system prompt in opencode.jsonc; document manual injection path.

SUCCESS_METRIC.METRIC: After Phase-105, LLM agent in new project follows GRACE workflow ≥90% of coding sessions (measured by grace_audit tool calls per session).
0 sessions where agent writes >50 lines of code with 0 GRACE tool calls.
User no longer needs to manually verify GRACE compliance — system enforces it automatically.
